subject.why: It is clearly a vintage red rotary telephone with the handset, coiled cord, and the requested heart detail in the dial center.

category.why: The telephone rests on a stylized wooden tabletop with a clean, smooth purple gradient wall behind it, strictly adhering to category 3.

clean.why: There is no text, numbers on the dial, UI, frames, watermarks, or characters.

framing.why: The phone is well-centered with comfortable margins around the edges and nothing cut off.

colour.why: The palette is bright, saturated, and warm, with the coral-red telephone popping strongly against the purple background.

detail.why: Shapes are clean and chunky without unwanted micro-textures, noise, or superfluous props.

style.why: The 3D rendering features smooth volumes and a soft satin sheen that matches the reference style.
